seo.title: Fort Lauderdale Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Fort Lauderdale.

page.heading: FORT LAUDERDALE - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Broward Homeless Helpline: 954-563-4357. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call the Broward Homeless Helpline at 954-563-4357 for shelter assessment and referral. Most shelters do not accept direct walk-ins.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Broward Homeless Helpline
entries.description: Central access line for shelter assessment, outreach, and homeless services. A call does not guarantee placement.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain your location, household, and immediate needs.

entries.title: Broward Partnership
entries.description: Emergency shelter and housing-focused services. Access generally requires referral through the Homeless Helpline; beds are not guaranteed.

entries.title: Broward Partnership — meals
entries.description: Meals for people experiencing homelessness; access rules and schedules can change.
entries.how_to_access: Check at the front desk or call before traveling.

entries.title: Broward food and shower resources
entries.description: Broward Partnership publishes current guidance for food, showers, outreach, and other basic services.
entries.how_to_access: Open the current guide or call the Homeless Helpline.

entries.title: Broward Health homeless health care
entries.description: Primary and related health care services for people experiencing homelessness. Clinic schedules and eligibility vary.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the program or ask the Homeless Helpline for the current clinic location.

entries.title: MyACCESS Florida
entries.description: Apply for food assistance, Medicaid, and temporary cash assistance.
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or ask a shelter case worker for help; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: CareerSource Broward
entries.description: Free public job-search assistance, career guidance, workshops, and training information.
entries.how_to_access: Find the closest center and confirm walk-in hours.

entries.title: Legal Aid Service of Broward County
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income residents; case acceptance depends on issue and capacity.

entries.title: Women In Distress of Broward County
entries.description: Confidential domestic-violence crisis support, safety planning, shelter, and referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain that you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk.
